positions.title: Experiment Engineer
positions.description:
- Built A/B experiments with JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- Experiment platforms included: Optimizely, Convert and VWO.
- Coordinated with a distributed remote team of developers and product managers.
- Assessed build complexity and communicated delivery timelines.
- As a full-time employee, engaged with managers and team leads to coordinate on personal and departmental OKRs.

positions.title: Experiment Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
- Built A/B experiments with JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- Experiment platforms included: Optimizely, Convert and VWO.
- Coordinated with a distributed remote team of developers and product managers.
- Assessed build complexity and communicated delivery timelines.

positions.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Developed custom WordPress themes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP.
- Converted static graphic designs into dynamic theme templates.
- Maintained and updated 20+ WordPress custom themes.
- Ensured custom themes were mobile responsive and aligned with SEO best practices.
- Designed corporate identity graphics for web and print.
- Worked fully remote and coordinated with multiple stakeholders across multiple projects.
positions.insights: Skills: W3C Standards · Usability · Web Graphics · Software Development · Web Technologies · Communication · Responsive Web Design · SASS · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Web Accessibility · Cross-browser Compatibility

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- In-house developer and graphic designer  for medical supplies and equipment e-commerce site.
- Designed corporate identity graphics for web and print. 
- Developed front-end templates for ASP based site using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

positions.title: Web designer/Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- In-house web designer and frontend developer for internet marketing and development agency. 
- Lead designer on multiple projects; primarily involving small to mid-sized web-based retailers. 
- Web UI/UX designs were translated to front-end templates using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
